name: prepare_display_and_copy_table
description: Forbids multitasking and disables audio DMA and interrupts, then waits on a loop for a button. It copies bytes from a marked source table into destination buffers and sets the copper pointer before returning.

name: build_copper_and_copy_tiles
description: Writes bitplane pointer pairs into two copper lists using a fixed row stride, then sets DMA and sprite pointer words. For each character of a stored string it copies an eight-byte tile through a lookup until the end marker.

name: copy_tile_rows_from_string
description: For each character of a string, maps it through a lookup to a tile index and copies eight bytes of that tile into a destination at a forty-byte row stride. After forty characters it moves to the next block and stops at the end marker.

name: copy_big_table_to_low
description: Copies 768 bytes from a fixed source table into low memory, one byte at a time. It has no return value.

name: tick_countdown_and_scale_value
description: Decrements a countdown byte while it is nonzero, calling a routine when it reaches zero. It then replaces a value with itself plus sixteen times its low byte.

name: blit_text_tiles_with_markers
description: Sets the blitter registers for a fixed copy, then for each character of a stored string copies an eight-row tile from a table into a destination row. Two marker characters switch the routine into a number-encoding path.

name: read_mouse_movement_position
description: Reads the mouse port movement counters and updates a stored horizontal position by the difference from the previous reading. It clamps the position and then writes four derived values from its top bits.

name: divide_offset_byte_by_eight
description: Adds 126 to a byte, wraps the result to eight bits, divides it by eight and stores it back in the same location. It has no other effect.

name: update_two_digit_counter_display
description: Checks a button port and increments or decrements a digit counter held in a text buffer, with modular digit wrap. It then copies the eight-row tile of the digit to a screen location through a lookup.

name: copy_strided_bytes_to_bitmap
description: Copies eight bytes spaced forty bytes apart from a source to a destination computed from row and column values. It returns nothing.

name: wait_with_countdown_loop
description: Runs a short countdown loop from a difference of two globals, returning when it reaches minus one. It is a busy-wait with no other effect.

name: wait_blitter_flag_clear
description: Repeatedly masks a status word in the record down to its busy bit until that bit is clear, a blitter-style wait loop. It writes nothing else.

name: handle_flag_bit_event
description: Clears all but bit four of a flag word in the record and, when that bit was set, stores sixteen into a timer field and calls several helper routines. A global flag selects an extra helper path.

name: clear_pointer_table_by_threshold
description: Searches a byte table for the first entry above a threshold, then clears a table of thirty pointer entries and stores the matching pointers into a second table. It sets mode and count globals afterwards; the listed fire-button facts are not visible in its own writes.

name: restart_audio_channel_pointers
description: Advances a frame counter and, when it runs out, waits in fixed delay loops around a DMA bit change. It then copies stored pointer and length words into the four audio channel location registers, or otherwise steps an envelope value through a table.

name: process_audio_channel_effect
description: Decodes one effect command from a stored word and applies it to a channel value. The command either slides the value down, slides it up, or steps it toward a stored target, clamping the result to fixed limits before writing it back.

name: sequence_audio_channel_step
description: Reads the next packed sequence byte and, when its instrument nibble is nonzero, loads that instrument's pointer, length, volume and period values into the channel record. It then applies the stored effect and writes the updated pointer and period back to the record.

name: apply_channel_effect_to_record
description: Applies the effect nibble of a channel record. It either returns the stored period unchanged, slides it up or down within fixed clamps, or steps it toward a target value by a stored step, writing the result back to the record and returning it.

name: copy_channel_word_field
description: Copies one 16-bit field from the channel record at offset sixteen into the output structure at offset six and returns. It has no other effect.

name: find_target_period_from_table
description: Scans a row of a word table, selected by an index byte, for the first entry greater than the current value. It stores that entry as a target and sets a direction flag when the value lies below it, with no hardware writes.

name: slide_value_toward_target
description: Moves a stored value toward a target by a fixed step in one of two directions, clamping it when it arrives. It then looks up a table entry from the new value and stores that entry in the output record.

name: compute_oscillating_offset_value
description: Computes a periodic offset from a waveform selected by two bits: a table lookup, a ramp, or a constant. The offset is scaled by a depth nibble, given a sign, and added to a base value, while a phase byte advances by a rate nibble.

name: dispatch_effect_command
description: Dispatches on the low nibble of a command byte. Its cases add a scaled step to a counter, set a global, clamp a position, store a value into the output, or update flags and timing values, returning a result to the caller each time.

name: store_low_nibble_field
description: Stores the low four bits of one byte in the record into a second byte field of the same record. It returns immediately with no other effect.

name: load_boot_blocks_and_halt
description: Issues disk read requests through the system I/O library into fixed memory locations, copies a block of data into low memory, then enters an infinite loop. The copy writes the table the loaded code is expected to use.

key: Vroom (1991)(Lankhor)[cr VF - Company][t +21 ATX].adf boot-block load +$8EA00 to $050000 (20480 bytes):0:0008
name: copy_vector_table_and_jump
description: Copies one hundred longs from a source table into low memory, then jumps through the loaded entry if its value is nonzero. Otherwise it stops on an unimplemented instruction marker.

key: Vroom (1991)(Lankhor)[cr VF - Company][t +21 ATX].adf boot-block load +$8EA00 to $050000 (20480 bytes):0:0044
name: call_library_jump_entry
description: Calls a routine through a fixed negative offset from a base register, which the decompiler could not resolve into a jump table, and then returns.

key: Vroom (1991)(Lankhor)[cr VF - Company][t +21 ATX].adf boot-block load +$8EA00 to $050000 (20480 bytes):0:0078
name: unpack_bitstream_backward_copy
description: Decodes a compressed bitstream into memory, first moving the packed source when it overlaps the destination. Decoding alternates literal bytes with back-references whose length and distance come from bit-coded fields and small tables.

key: Vroom (1991)(Lankhor)[cr VF - Company][t +21 ATX].adf boot-block load +$8EA00 to $050000 (20480 bytes):0:00A0
name: decode_bitstream_literals_and_matches
description: Decodes a bit-coded stream of literal bytes and back-references into a forward output buffer, reading each length from a table and each distance from bit fields. It ends when the stream's terminator is reached.

key: Vroom (1991)(Lankhor)[cr VF - Company][t +21 ATX].adf boot-block load +$8EA00 to $050000 (20480 bytes):0:0134
name: decode_bitstream_continuation
description: Continues the bit-coded decoder by reading a length from a table and a distance from bit fields before copying from earlier output. It returns to the decoding loop shared with its neighbours.

key: Vroom (1991)(Lankhor)[cr VF - Company][t +21 ATX].adf boot-block load +$D1000 to $020000 (16384 bytes):0:0116
name: shift_bit_reader_word

name: parse_amiga_hunk_relocations
description: Walks the hunk list of a loaded executable, allocating memory for each code and data hunk through the system library and copying its contents. It reads relocation records to patch absolute addresses and stops at the end-of-file hunk.

name: busy_wait_countdown_loop
description: Decrements a 16-bit register in a tight loop until its count wraps past zero, producing a pure busy-wait delay. The pseudo-code touches no memory or hardware, and the listed library offsets are not visible in its body.

key: bubba 'n' stix (1994)(core design)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Bubba 'N' Stix (1994)(Core Design)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:PaRaDoX:0:01CC
name: unpack_backward_lz_stream
description: Decodes a compressed byte stream into a buffer working backwards from its end. It reads flag bits, then either copies literal bytes or copies a run from earlier in the output, repeating until the buffer start is reached.

key: bubba 'n' stix (1994)(core design)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Bubba 'N' Stix (1994)(Core Design)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:PaRaDoX:0:0218
name: shift_bitstream_with_carry
description: Shifts a multi-word bit buffer by a count taken from the low bits of a register, refilling from memory when the buffer empties. The shifted-out bit is carried forward as the extend flag for a fixed number of steps.

key: bubba 'n' stix (1994)(core design)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Bubba 'N' Stix (1994)(Core Design)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:PaRaDoX:0:026C

name: unpack_first_version_block
description: Searches a linked list of blocks for one carrying a first-version four-byte signature. It copies that block's data through literal and back-reference runs, calling helper routines for the bit decoding, and returns its registers unchanged.

key: bubba 'n' stix (1994)(core design)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Bubba 'N' Stix (1994)(Core Design)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:Bubba:0:0104
name: extract_flag_bit_from_table
description: Scans a table of word pairs until a masked value matches its partner, then reads a byte from the matching entry and uses it to extract a bit from a mask. It calls a helper when a signed comparison borrows and returns the resulting bit mask.

key: bubba 'n' stix (1994)(core design)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Bubba 'N' Stix (1994)(Core Design)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:Bubba:0:013E
name: mask_and_conditional_call
description: Ands two 16-bit values, and when one signed byte is less than another it calls a helper and returns that helper's word instead. Otherwise it returns the masked value.

key: bubba 'n' stix (1994)(core design)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Bubba 'N' Stix (1994)(Core Design)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:Bubba:0:014A
name: stub_empty_return
description: The routine body is only a return with no work, so it does nothing and is a stub.

name: build_bit_length_decode_tables
description: Reads a count and then, for each of sixteen bit lengths, computes a bit mask and a shifted code value from a stack buffer. The results are stored into two lookup tables that drive the bit decoder.

key: bubba 'n' stix (1994)(core design)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Bubba 'N' Stix (1994)(Core Design)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:Bubba:0:01EA
name: apply_hunk_relocation_entries
description: Walks a relocation list whose blocks carry a hunk type code. For each entry it finds the target hunk by counting down through the hunk list, then adds that hunk's base address to each longword named by the entry's offsets.

name: setup_copper_and_restore_dma
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, then saves the DMA control state and disables DMA and interrupts. It sets two stored pointer values and a delay counter, polls the right button port in a loop, and finally restores the saved DMA bits.

name: wait_status_then_set_bit
description: Polls a status byte until it equals a fixed value and a second flag byte is nonzero. It then returns the first register with a single bit set at the position given by the second register.

name: wait_status_flags_ready
description: Polls the same two status bytes as its neighbour and returns once the flag conditions hold. It sets no bits and writes nothing.

name: run_until_flag_cleared
description: Sets a flag word to one and repeatedly calls a helper routine, touching a custom chip register around each call, until the helper clears the flag.

name: initialize_bitplane_pointer_table
description: Fills a fifteen-entry table with values that rise by a fixed stride, then writes a constant and a count into each of seven following eight-byte records.

name: render_text_stream_glyphs
description: Waits on a delay counter, then reads characters from a stored string and treats a line-feed or zero byte as an end marker. Each other character is drawn from a glyph table as eight rows at an eighty-byte row stride, with pixels inverted when a flag is set.

name: select_alternating_plane_pointer
description: Counts down a timer and, when it expires, toggles a byte and picks one of two buffer addresses to store into the copper pointer words. A flag selects a fixed third buffer address instead, and nothing is written while the timer runs.

name: pack_four_byte_record_flags
description: Writes a four-byte record to the buffer at the address register: the low bytes of two inputs and of their sum, plus a flag byte recording the ninth bit of each value. It is a packing helper with no hardware access.

name: advance_state_machine_counter
description: Steps a small state machine in which a counter moves a value up or down in steps of four depending on the current state. When the counter runs out it advances to the next table entry and stores a computed pointer into two copper location words.

name: setup_blit_control_block
description: Waits for the blitter to become free, then stores a long pointer, a zero count and a constant into a control block and stores a combined word of two inputs into a field. It returns nothing.
